meaning:
ἀμφιέννυμι
(ἕννυμι, to clothe),
to clothe: Mat.6:30 11:8, Luk.7:25 (cf. ἀμφιάζω).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists, and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?
But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed, and live delicately, are in kings’ courts.
